description: This file defines a base class 'BaseObject' for Pipecat components, providing event handling, lifecycle management, and unique identification. It includes data structures for event handlers and methods for managing events asynchronously.

classes.name: EventHandler
classes.description: Data class to store information about event handlers, including name, list of handlers, and sync/async execution flag.

classes.name: BaseObject
classes.description: Abstract base class providing common functionality for Pipecat objects, including event handling, unique ID, naming, and async cleanup.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Asynchronously cleans up resources, waiting for all event handler tasks to complete.

methods.name: event_handler
methods.description: Decorator for registering event handlers for specific events.

methods.name: add_event_handler
methods.description: Adds a handler function to a specified event.

methods.name: _register_event_handler
methods.description: Registers an event type with optional sync/async execution.

methods.name: _call_event_handler
methods.description: Calls all handlers registered for a specific event, managing sync and async handlers.

methods.name: _run_handler
methods.description: Executes a handler, awaiting if it is a coroutine, with error handling.

methods.name: _event_task_finished
methods.description: Removes completed event handler tasks from tracking.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns the object's name as its string representation.
